title: Resident's Own Medicare Coinsurance Deducted from a Coming Pending Month's Estimate
content:
For an advance toward a coming pending month under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage, the resident's own share of Part A coinsurance expected in that month is deducted from the month's estimate. It is read from the resident's Medicare coverage — the resident's coverage in status active under Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage.

**Schedule.** The resident's own Medicare coinsurance deducted from a coming pending month's estimate, read from the resident's Medicare coverage: where the benefit days past the twentieth left at the start of the coming month are at least the coming month's days, every day of the coming month; where some but fewer are left, only the days left; in either case those days are priced at the Medicare daily skilled nursing coinsurance of the coming month's calendar year times the resident share percent of that coverage's cost-sharing tier divided by 100, rounded half up to the cent; otherwise, including a coverage no longer active, nothing. The deduction enters the estimate before its floor at zero.

**Daily coinsurance by calendar year of the coming month.**

| Coming month falls in | Daily coinsurance used |
|---|---|
| 2026 | 217.00 dollars |
| 2025 | 209.50 dollars |
| any other year | the daily coinsurance most recently booked on that coverage, nothing where none was booked |

**Benefit days past the twentieth left at the start of the coming month** are 100 less the larger of 20 and the total of the benefit days already used in the benefit period (the coverage's prior skilled nursing days in the period, none where not recorded, plus its covered days used) and the days from the first day of the current month to the first day of the coming month, never below zero.

**Worked schedule (hypothetical coverage with a resident share of 25 percent; a 30-day coming month in 2026; a 31-day current month).**

| Days already used in the period | Total with the current month's 31 days | Days left past the twentieth | Days priced | Deduction |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 41 | 72 | 28 | 28 | 28 at 217.00 at 25 percent: 1,519.00 |
| 10 | 41 | 59 | 30 | 30 at 217.00 at 25 percent: 1,627.50 |
| 85 | 116 | 0 | none | nothing |

With no coverage in status active, nothing is deducted.
